subject: Re: [stan-users] Matrix slice/segment by rows or columns

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Matrix slice/segment by rows or columns
parts:
I'm not sure what you want segment_rows() to do, but there's
a section in the manual on the blocking and slicing operations
for matrices. You can pull out an arbitrary contiguous subblock
from a matrix, or pull a row or column from a matrix and segment
that if that's what you want. And there are conversion functions
from matrices to vectors and back again.

- Bob

> On Oct 30, 2015, at 2:42 PM, John Reid <johnba...@gmail.com> wrote:
>
> As far as I can work out, I cannot segment (slice) a matrix by rows or columns, i.e.
>
> matrix[10, 7] m;
> vector[3] mu;
> vector[7] x;
> x ~ normal(mu * segment_rows(m, 2, 3), 1)
>
>
>
> but as I wasn't 100% sure, I thought I would check by asking.
>
> Thanks for a great piece of software,
> John.
>
>
